title_zh: 为保护模型决定延后搬运

scenario.goal_zh: 说明立即搬运的风险，决定等合适箱子到位再搬并通知接收方延期

context_zh: 展览制作人员准备搬运一个纸制建筑模型。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: The driver is waiting. Can we carry the model out without a box?

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: That is risky. One sharp turn could ruin the thin paper towers.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: I do not want to rush this just because the van is here.

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: Neither do I. The fitted box will be ready tomorrow. We should move the model then.

sentences.speaker: Jules
sentences.text: Agreed. I'll tell the gallery the delivery will be a day late and explain why.

sentences.speaker: Amir
sentences.text: I'll let the driver know we are not loading it today, and I'll check the box before tomorrow's trip.
